'''Nar Kaaga''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]], [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] world that survived on [[Merchant/Legends|trade]]. It was home to the [[H'uun]] and [[Shell Hutts|Shell]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clans.
